# marked 9.1.6 (vendored)

`marked.esm.js` is `lib/marked.esm.js` from the `marked@9.1.6` package on the npm registry,
copied unchanged on 2026-11-15.

    sha256  f750c996a1f164ad98b43699e7c88b194209edcfb8dc5c4dcc019633d9b27eb7

It is committed so that a build installs nothing and cannot be changed by a registry. It is
the same release the Psychiatry Clerkship Library vendors. MIT licensed; see `LICENSE.md`.

To update: replace the file from a newer package, update the hash above, and run `npm test`.
The renderer hooks this site relies on (`heading`, `link`, `table`) are in `src/lib/render.mjs`.
